profile_text.body:
Salesforce's website for Slack AI describes the tool as a way to boost productivity by summarizing chats, searching files, taking meeting notes, translating conversations, and automating workflows. The company says Slackbot is a personal AI agent that understands the user and workspace, helps prepare for meetings, analyze reports, and create project briefs. The site states that AI in Slack runs within Slack's trusted boundary, customer data is not used to train large language models, and LLM providers do not have access to customer data. Slack is described as the conversational UI for Agentforce, with agents built with Agentforce able to run directly in Slack channels, threads, and direct messages.

Salesforce's AI products include Slack AI for messaging, Tableau AI (Einstein) for business intelligence with natural language queries and Trust Layer governance, and Salesforce Einstein / Agentforce for CRM-embedded AI and agents. The company is a public company headquartered in San Francisco, CA, founded in 1999, and trades under the ticker CRM. It files with the SEC under CIK 0001108524. Its most recent 10-K reports revenue of $41,525,000,000 for the fiscal year ended January 31, 2026. The company has 281 law exposure entries in California. Several MCP servers are listed for Salesforce administration and SOQL queries, including ai.cirra/salesforce-mcp and ai.smithery/kodey-ai-salesforce-mcp.
